summary: Diff implements a new AdminPanel layout with sidebar navigation and new admin sections (overview cards, parents/children user lists, login analytics UI, battery status UI), adds battery reporting and login event recording in the app, and extends i18n with admin-related strings. Several unrelated features/behavior changes were also introduced (e.g., profile setup/admin role gating by phone number, added polling in parent views, pairing code clipboard behavior, admin password changes).

hallucinated_features.description: Profile setup changes: Administrator role hidden by default and only appears when a specific phone number is entered; includes password visibility toggle and other behavior not requested by the BuildRequest.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked to replace AdminPanel and add admin dashboard features (user lists, login analytics, battery reporting) and i18n; it did not request changing role-selection logic or gating admin role by a specific phone number.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetupDialog.tsx summary mentions admin option shown only when phone number (91)980115950 is entered)

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed periodic polling (15-second intervals) in several parent/child views (ChildSummaryCard, ActivityView, LocationView) beyond the admin dashboard scope.
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goal/requirements did not request real-time/near-real-time polling for these views; requested admin dashboard changes only (and explicitly said no websockets/streaming for dashboards, not general app polling).
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (summaries for frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSummaryCard.tsx, ActivityView.tsx, LocationView.tsx mention 15-second polling)

hallucinated_features.description: Pairing setup behavior change: generates 6-digit backend pairing codes and copies only the code (not a URL) to clipboard with updated toast messaging.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of requested admin dashboard replacement, user lists, login analytics, battery reporting, queries, or i18n updates.

hallucinated_features.description: TransparencyPolicies modal content/translation overhaul and Tailwind class tweak.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; unrelated to admin dashboard replacement and metrics features.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend introduces a 'New Strict Admin Password' variable with a hard-coded value.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask to add or change admin password semantics; it only required admin-only authorization checks for admin data and keeping backend as a single actor.
evidence: backend/main.mo (shows comment 'New Strict Admin Password' and `var adminPassword : Text = "Tigguindoprojetox1";`)
